name: Xpel Argan Oil Heat Defence Leave In Spray 150ml
description:
Xpel Argan Oil Heat Defence Leave-In Spray 150ml

Protect your hair from heat styling while keeping it soft and silky with Xpel Argan Oil Heat Defence Leave-In Spray.

Key Benefits:

Heat Protection: Shields hair from damage caused by blow dryers, straighteners, and curling irons.

Soft & Smooth Hair: Enriched with Argan Oil to leave hair nourished, silky, and manageable.

Easy to Use: Simply spray on damp or dry hair before styling for instant protection.

Volume: 150ml | Developed in UK, Manufactured in PRC

Perfect For: All hair types seeking protection from heat styling while maintaining healthy, smooth hair.
